title: King Sorrow
author: Joe Hill
notes: Arthur Oakes is a reader, a dreamer, and a student at Rackham College, Maine, renowned for its frosty winters, exceptional library, and beautiful buildings

title: Physics for Cats
author: Tom Gauld
notes: Tom Gauld returns with Physics for Cats, his second collection of science-based cartoons for the New Scientist. Find out why every scientist worth his sodium chloride has a Tom Gauld cartoon taped to his electron microscope

title: We Did Ok, Kid: A Memoir
author: Anthony Hopkins
notes: Academy Award-winning actor Sir Anthony Hopkins delves into his illustrious film and theatre career, difficult childhood and path to sobriety in his honest, moving and long-awaited memoir.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
notes: No matter your goals, Atomic Habits offers a proven framework for improving—every day.

title: The Nuclear Age
author: Serhii Plokhy
notes: A sweeping history of the geopolitics behind the nuclear arms race, from the first atomic bomb to today's rush to stockpile nuclear weapons.
